SPECIAL ABILITIES

Crystalline Form (Ex)

Mineral elementals gain a +2 racial bonus to AC against rays thanks to their reflective crystalline skin.

Earth Glide (Ex)

A burrowing mineral elemental can pass through stone, dirt, or almost any other sort of earth except metal as easily as a fish swims through water. If protected against fire damage, it can even glide through lava. Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. A move earth spell cast on an area containing a burrowing mineral elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.

Mineral Sense (Sp)

Mineral elementals can detect metals and minerals in their surroundings as with a rod of metal and mineral detection.

Natural Weapon Versatility: A mineral elemental can shape its extremities into pounding hammers, vicious points, or keen blades. As a swift action, it can alter its slam damage to deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

Sharp Edges (Ex)

A mineral elemental’s natural attacks are treated as adamantine weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Vulnerabilities (Ex)

A mineral elemental takes maximum damage from a chill metal or heat metal spell (no save). Repel metal or stone has the effect of hold monster on the elemental.

Warp metal inflicts 1d4 damage per caster level, and transmute metal to wood deals 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to the elemental. It can attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC 17 + caster’s ability modifier) to reduce the damage from these spells by half.

ABOUT

This creature appears as a glistening, rough statue of ore, with little multicolored crystals embedded in its body and gems for eyes.
